units: <cite ref="Sukkah 49b:5">Succ. 49ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 28:7">Num. XXVIII, 7</cite>). <he>לשון שתייה לשון שביעה  לשון ש׳</he> expressing drinking, fill, plenty; Y. ib. IV, 54ᵈ top <he>לשון חיבה … ש׳</he>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21:17">Num. R. s. 21<sup>17</sup></cite>; Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 12; a. e., v. <cite ref="T00361"><he>רְוִיָּה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Num. R. s. 10<sup>2</sup></cite> [read:] <he>מנבל פיו ומדבר דברים רעים בש׳ וכ׳</he> he defiles his mouth and talks bad words in his drunkenness, and is not ashamed.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Ib</cite>.<sup>8</sup> <he>עמדו … מתוך הש׳</he> they stood up and smote one another in their drunkenness.

<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:1-4">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>ל״ש … לשִׁיכָּרוּתוֹ של לוט וכ׳</he> this (that the drunken man can be held to legal responsibility) has been taught only, when he has not reached the degree of Lot’s drunkenness (unconsciousness), but when he has &c.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 90b:11">B. Mets. 90ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 10:9">Lev. X, 9</cite>) <he>בשעת ביאה לא תהא ש׳</he> at the time of entering (the Temple for service) no effect of the wine should be felt; a. fr.
